expression:
http.host in {"zockdiewandan.online" "www.zockdiewandan.online" "zdwa.zockdiewandan.online" "zilch.zockdiewandan.online"}
and not cf.client.bot
and not (
  starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/spieler/")
  or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/zdwa/spieler/")
  or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/zilch/spieler/")
  or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/api/players/")
  or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/api/zilch/players/")
)
and (
  ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".php")
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php/"
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-admin/"
  or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin")
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-content/"
  or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content")
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-includes/"
  or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes")
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-json/"
  or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-json")
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.env"
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.git/"
  or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.git")
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.svn/"
  or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.svn")
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.hg/"
  or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.hg")
  or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/cgi-bin/")
  or lower(http.request.uri.path) in {"/cgi-bin" "/server-status" "/server-info" "/actuator"}
  or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/actuator/")
)
